messages:
carmen_prod: follow-up from the postmortem  we saw the same kv-eviction pattern twice in the last month. want to convert remediation into a compact, owned test surface so we don't regress again. proposal: (1) tiny CI fault-injector, (2) nightly tenant-blast, (3) incident-derived promptset evals, (4) recurrence alert + oncall rotation. owners below.
leo_sre: +1. CI step must be non-flaky and <8m. I can help build the injector and the recurrence alert. will add owner-rotation metadata so oncall knows next person to ping.
anya_ml: I can own promptset and eval harness. brief plan: 8-12 targeted prompts that recreate long-context churn and noisy short bursts. wire outputs into nightly eval and a dashboard. ETA: 2 sprints. filing RINF-7200.
rashid_platform: I'll take CI fault-injection and the nightly tenant-blast job. plan: k6 -> k8s job, simulate 40 normal tenants + 1 noisy tenant, ramp and sustain patterns. will add cost cap and test org creds. filing RINF-7201.
carmen_prod: please tag tickets with 'postmortem-eval' and link to the postmortem. soft dates: CI PR by 2024-12-12, promptset in nightly by 2024-12-28, nightly integrated by 2025-01-10, recurrence alert + rotation by 2024-12-20.
leo_sre: recurrence alert spec: if eviction-rate > 2x baseline twice in 72h, open a P0 candidate and ping the oncall then the ticket owner. will add an automated owner escalation chain.
anya_ml: promptset sketch (short descriptors) I'll add to RINF-7200 repo:
P1: multi-turn 12k context with repeated backrefs to hit KV reads
P2: 100 concurrent short queries to same convo id to create contention
P3: mixed-tenant: 39 normal + 1 noisy long-update tenant
METRICS: eviction-rate, p95-latency, quality-proxy
Fail gates: eviction-rate delta >10% OR p95 > +20% OR quality proxy drop >5%
rashid_platform: nightly plan: ramp 10->200 users over 12m, sustain 90m, repeat x2. run both hosted-only and hosted+dedicated to validate routing fallbacks. infra checklist & cost estimate in RINF-7201.
leo_sre: CI plan: tiny fault-injector job that flips a feature flag to lower KV cache for 30s. run as optional canary on PRs and required on release branches. I'll coordinate permissions with eng-sre.
carmen_prod: scheduling a 30m sync to unblock infra creds and align runbook owners: Wed 10:00 PT. invite to @anya_ml @rashid_platform @leo_sre @oncall-bot
oncall-bot: Calendar invite created: "Postmortem coverage sprint alignment" Wed 10:00 PT  link: https://calendar.redwood/postmortem-coverage-sync
anya_ml: will draft PR template for promptset additions (description, minimal repro, failure gates) and add eval thresholds to RINF-7200: quality proxy <5% regression, p95 <= +15% under baseline load.
rashid_platform: noted. if infra or billing blockers appear, escalate to eng-sre + finance and cc @carmen_prod. I'll add cost guard fields to RINF-7201.
carmen_prod: action items summary: RINF-7200 (promptset+eval) RINF-7201 (CI+nightly) RINF-7202 (recurrence alert+rotation). owners: anya_ml, rashid_platform, leo_sre. update tickets when PRs open. thanks all :thumbsup:
